verdict.rationale: AvaTax provides jurisdiction-aware tax calculation, tax code recommendations, and nexus data via API/MCP, which supports differentiated SaaS/digital-goods taxability determinations, but there is no evidence of visible research/rationale behind each determination, no documented handling of bundled-offering taxability logic, and no SaaS-specific taxability guidance. missing for 10: transparent research/citations behind each taxability determination, explicit bundled-offering taxability rules, SaaS-specific taxability examples, independent validation of accuracy on hard cases.
